summary: Cellyan Biotechnology, a Nasdaq-listed Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its notice and proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting on September 21, 2026, in Shenzhen, China. The sole disclosed agenda item is a 1-for-20 share consolidation of Class A and Class B ordinary shares, plus a corresponding reduction of authorized capital from 1 billion to 50 million shares, with fractional shares rounded up. No price, stake, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The structural note is the Nasdaq-approved reverse split used to repair minimum bid price compliance; watch for Nasdaq effectiveness, any unrelated proposals in the full special resolution, and post-split trading liquidity.
